description: Versatile Functions: The BOSCH GSR 120-LI Cordless Drill Driver is ideal for drilling wood, sheet metal, and driving screws. It can drill up to 20mm in wood and 10mm in steel, making it a versatile tool for various tasks across different industries. Weighing just 0.8 kg with the battery, it combines power and durability for efficient screwdriving and drilling. No-Load Speed and Torque: This cordless drill driver offers a no-load speed of 0-400 RPM in 1st gear and 0-1500 RPM in 2nd gear, adapting seamlessly to diverse tasks. It delivers 30 Nm of torque for hard materials and 14 Nm for soft materials, ensuring optimal performance in drilling and driving applications. The 2-speed gearbox enhances productivity while providing excellent torque. The variable speed feature allows for precise RPM control, making tasks easier and more efficient. Powerful Lithium-Ion Battery: Powered by a robust 12V lithium-ion battery, the GSR 120-LI ensures long-lasting performance with minimal self-discharge. The battery charges quickly and provides consistent power for a wide range of applications. Enhanced with Electronic Cell Protection technology, it offers extended battery life and tool durability, making it a reliable choice for long-term use. Ergonomic Soft Grip: The ergonomic soft grip ensures exceptional comfort during extended use, reducing hand strain. Its textured surface provides better handling and control, especially during high-torque operations. This thoughtful design enhances user experience by ensuring a secure and comfortable grip. Suitable for Various Industries: Perfect for electricians, furniture manufacturers, modular kitchen installers, interior decorators, panel manufacturers and HSRP installers. This tool kit caters to the diverse needs of professional's use.
